description: This file defines the interface SortFieldExpression used to create query sorting options based on specific fields within the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends other expression interfaces and includes visitor pattern methods for evaluation.

methods.name: acceptSortVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a SortFieldExpressionVisitor to evaluate or process this expression.

methods.name: acceptFilterVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a FilterFieldExpressionVisitor for processing as part of filter expression evaluation.

methods.name: acceptExistsVisitor
methods.description: Accepts an ExistsFieldExpressionVisitor for processing existence checks.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a general FieldExpressionVisitor to perform operations defined by the visitor.
